summary: workstation-128g/v1 clamps admission to policy, executable, provider, pressure, and DB budgets; every tier increase requires same-RC evidence.
invariants: verification tier is 4 slots after >=120 GiB physical-memory preflight
admission capacity is the minimum of configured policy, executable slots, provider cap, and live pressure cap
C5, C10, and C16 evidence digests must match the active release-candidate digest
C16 additionally requires a recovery evidence digest and at least 86400 seconds
owner generation remains 1 active and 3 queued
PowerPoint COM remains one concurrent operation
forbidden: activating 8, 12, or 16 slots without matching same-RC evidence
advertising configured slots that have no executable worker capacity
